text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose again. I'll win next time,
because I'm
number one.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah. As if.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Excuse you?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
After some intense conditioning, I'm
gonna come
back stronger than ever!
The next race is as good
as mine!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Mine!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Why you...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I don't have time to waste
standing here.
I'm revamping my training
schedule as soon as I
get home!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap! Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka sure
are
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? Just knowing those two
are gonna
be racing each other gets me
hyped up like
nothing else!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How frustrating. I fell just a little too
short.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm determined to do even better in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who chose to run sprints. I
don't
regret that decision.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? Vodka and Scarlet
are both
really great runners.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The thought of a race where those two
clash is
enough to get anyone excited.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That means I'll have to work harder than
ever and
dig even deeper if I still want
to leave my mark on
the path I've
chosen...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Starting with the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan starts walking slowly in
the
opposite direction of the hotel we
booked, so I
rush out to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's Kyoto in the fall. I have to get some
pictures
with the foliage.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Do you want to come?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan and I enjoy a
stroll around
the city, taking in the
vibrant red and orange
leaves.
